scenario: Bare extraction on raw Time rejection per LTIM.6.2. Component slots (`.hour`, `.minute`, `.day`, etc.) on a raw `Time` value reject; the author must go through the `.utc` or `.local(tz)` member to declare timezone context. Pin: `m.fired_at.hour` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_TIME_NEEDS_TZ_CONTEXT.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule trig:
    Event m where m.fired_at.hour > 12
->
    log info "x"
